name: Webinar · Logali HANA Guard · Reconcile company codes with OData

nodes.name: Read Released OData Company Codes
nodes.notes: Replace the host and select an authorized Basic Auth credential. The public workflow contains no endpoint credential.

parameters.content:
## One business question, two contracts

1. Read a bounded projection from `T001` with the client fixed to `250`.
2. Read the released company-code OData service.
3. Normalize both responses and classify each company as `MATCH`, `DIFFERENT`, `HANA_ONLY`, or `ODATA_ONLY`.

The exercise demonstrates movement and reconciliation without writing to S/4. A production design must document licensing, ownership, network controls, row/column scope, and the released-API alternative.
